verses.text: Here is a saying you can trust: if anyone wants to be a church leader, he wants to do a good work.

So a church leader must be someone no one can find fault with. He must have only one wife. He must control himself, think clearly, and behave well. He must welcome guests into his home and be good at teaching.
He must not drink too much or be violent. He must be gentle, not quick to argue, and he must not love money.
He must manage his own family well, and see that his children obey him and respect him fully.
If someone does not know how to manage his own family, how can he take care of God's church?
He must not be a new believer, or he may become proud and fall under the same judgment as the devil.
People outside the church must also speak well of him, so that he will not fall into shame and into the devil's trap.
In the same way, church helpers must be worthy of respect, and must mean what they say. They must not drink too much wine or be greedy for money.
With a clear conscience they must hold on to the deep truths of the faith.
They must first be tested. Then, if no one can find fault with them, let them serve.
In the same way, their wives must be worthy of respect. They must not spread lies about others. They must control themselves and be faithful in everything.
A church helper must have only one wife, and he must manage his children and his family well.
Those who serve well earn a good name for themselves, and great confidence in their faith in Christ Jesus.
I hope to come to you soon, but I am writing these things to you
so that, if I am delayed, you will know how people should behave in God's family. That family is the church of the living God, which holds up the truth like a pillar and a strong base.

No one can deny how great the secret of our faith is: God came as a human being. He was proved right by the Spirit. He was seen by angels. He was preached among the nations. People in the world believed in him. He was taken up to heaven in glory.
